purpose: Separate harness build/admission from Actor × Task qualification, bridge historical source-built realizations to immutable admitted artifacts, and stop each lane at the first informative boundary.

openworker.note: Initial admission exposed direct-reference dependency re-resolution. The same immutable payload was re-admitted with resolver-free wheelhouse hydration; actor profiles bind the strengthened v2 admission provenance.

goose.note: Native payload reproduced the previously characterized source-built Goose binary byte-for-byte.

compile_only_patch.description: crate recursion_limit raised to 256 after pinned upstream rustc query-depth overflow

bridge_observations.interpretation: Positive control passes from the admitted prebuilt artifact.
Reproduces the structural source-built boundary: one model round, no tool call, unchanged state, verifier failure.
Goose stream-json turn mapping removes the earlier zero-round instrumentation ambiguity; the admitted actor reaches inference and remains outside the task wall envelope.
Current-package bounded-repair crossover reaches an observed Ollama model round but remains outside the task wall envelope with unchanged state.

The admitted binary runs and local Ollama logs show repeated prompt processing, but the standardized receipt does not yet carry model-round evidence. Preserve as an integration/measurement boundary rather than a task-capability restriction; do not fan out to a harder task.

decisions: Build admission and actor qualification remain separate authorities.
Historical source-built evidence is preserved; admitted artifacts mint distinct configured actor identities.
OpenWorker bridge continuity is supported for the current controls; latency differences remain observations, not equivalence gates.
Goose bounded-debugging is now a terminal task-specific timeout observation for the prebuilt actor because two model rounds are directly observed.

Across the two current task packages, prebuilt OpenWorker is inside the text-repair envelope and outside bounded-debugging via false completion; prebuilt Goose is outside both 120-second task envelopes after reaching model inference. This is a configured-actor comparison, not a universal harness ranking.
Codex-exec stops at the simplest-task integration boundary; no bounded-debugging follow-on is justified until standardized post-model telemetry is available.
No universal harness ranking or automatic routing policy is derived.
